theorem ProbabilityTheory.extracted_1.{u_1} {S : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace S] (H : Set S)
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass S] [inst_2 : Finite ↑H] [inst_3 : Nonempty ↑H] :
  ↑(Nat.card ↑H) * (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog = log ↑(Nat.card ↑H) := by
  simp only [negMulLog, one_div, log_inv, mul_neg, neg_mul, neg_neg, ← mul_assoc]
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀, one_mul]
        simp only [ne_eq, Nat.cast_eq_zero, Nat.card_ne_zero]
        exact ⟨ ‹_›, ‹_› ⟩

theorem ProbabilityTheory.extracted_1.{u_1} {S : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace S] (H : Set S)
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass S] [inst_2 : Finite ↑H] [inst_3 : Nonempty ↑H] :
  ∑ s ∈ ⋯.toFinset, (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog = ↑(Nat.card ↑H) * (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog := by
  simp [← Set.ncard_coe_Finset, Set.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

theorem ProbabilityTheory.extracted_1.{u_1} {S : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace S] (H : Set S)
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass S] [inst_2 : Finite ↑H] [inst_3 : Nonempty ↑H] :
  (∑' (s : S), if s ∈ H then (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog else 0) =
    ∑ s ∈ ⋯.toFinset, (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog := by
  convert tsum_eq_sum (s := H.toFinite.toFinset) ?_ using 2 with s hs
        · simp at hs; simp [hs]
        intro s hs
        simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hs; simp [hs]
dependencies.name: extracted_split_ProbabilityTheory.entropy_of_uniformOn_3

theorem ProbabilityTheory.extracted_1.{u_1} {S : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace S] (H : Set S)
  [inst_1 : MeasurableSingletonClass S] [inst_2 : Finite ↑H] [inst_3 : Nonempty ↑H] :
  ∑' (s : S), (↑(Nat.card ↑(H ∩ {s})) / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog =
    ∑' (s : S), if s ∈ H then (1 / ↑(Nat.card ↑H)).negMulLog else 0 := by
  congr with s
        by_cases h : s ∈ H <;> simp [h, Finset.filter_true_of_mem, Finset.filter_false_of_mem]
dependencies.name: extracted_split_ProbabilityTheory.entropy_of_uniformOn_4

theorem filter_false_of_mem (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ¬p x) : s.filter p = ∅ := filter_eq_empty_iff.2 h

theorem filter_true_of_mem (h : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) : s.filter p = s := filter_eq_self.2 h

theorem Nat.card_coe_set_eq (s : Set α) : Nat.card s = s.ncard := by
  obtain (h | h) := s.finite_or_infinite
  · have := h.fintype
    rw [ncard, h.encard_eq_coe_toFinset_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
      toFinite_toFinset, toFinset_card, ENat.toNat_coe]
  have := infinite_coe_iff.2 h
  rw [ncard, h.encard_eq, Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite, ENat.toNat_top]
dependencies.name: Set.Nat.card_coe_set_eq
